body:
16 Nov 2026, P2-25 SLICES 2+3 BUILT, DRAFT PR #110 (built, not walked; NOT deployed; the item stays todo: slice 4, the rehome, remains). The lead and the advisor read the dry-run report BEFORE this merges.
WHAT: every server call site is on the one fold (refs.norm_key with no empty part, facts_to_fill, navidrome.pick_song, keeper/placement, cover_finder, artist_finder, imports/uploads, catalogue.release_key; the YouTube matcher through textnorm; MATCHER_REVISION 2; survives_fold_whole is era 1). keyrepair.py rewrites the stored keys at start-up before refmerge (one transaction after its own VACUUM INTO copy, never merges, idempotent, never stops the server), fills ref_recheck, nulls tombstone keys with an empty segment, voids the Deezer pictures the broken fold matched. refmerge holds a pair with a worklist ref (recheck_pending) and writes ref_merge.title/artist. Migration 0018 only adds those. The start-up REFUSES (ERROR, nothing written) on any Python whose Unicode is not the pin 15.0.0, 15.1.0 included.
DRY RUN on a COPY of VM 108's database (taken 15 Nov, schema 15; Python 3.12 = the image; the original hashed before and after, unchanged; full report with titles: local/p225s23-dryrun-report-2026-11-16.md, outside any git repo): 3,394 refs; 40 keys change (7 other-alphabet refs whose key was empty, 8 Latin start + dropped letter, 1 all-ASCII empty title, 24 typographic apostrophes); 3,354 unchanged. 15 refs the old fold damaged; 0 on the worklist (the database holds 3,232 keeper files and 12 library files, none on a damaged ref, so the worklist, the hold and the rehome ran on synthetic data only); 7 pictures voided; 0 of 174 tombstone keys nulled. 64 key-sharing groups before and after, 1 new (curly vs straight apostrophe, 7 s apart: neither finds the other); no ref disappears. refmerge: 0 merged, 6 held (different_source_video), identical with and without the worklist. Likes, entries, plays, ref_merge, ref_gone, files identical before and after; second run no-op. 0.2 s; synthetic 200,000 refs 8.9 s.
TESTS: seen red on main 95d1293 (textnorm_keys 32/50, fold_call_sites 15/20, refs 12 new, 2 flipped B-37 pins); the keyrepair/unicode/textnorm files fail at import there (honest, not a proof of logic), so 14 deliberate mutations show the invariants bite (all red). Saved real responses in app/test/fixtures/server still parse (4 Dart tests + text_fold_test, 258 pass).
FOR THE LEAD TO DECIDE: (1) test-side tolerance of Unicode 15.1.0 (dev venv 3.13) is the only deviation; the server has none, so a stack run from the 3.13 venv does NOT rewrite keys (ERROR in the log): run the bench under 3.12. (2) Refusal logs and serves; refuse to start instead? (3) TEXTNORM_REVISION stays 1: no key was ever stored at revision 1. (4) N-34 imports survives_fold_whole, era 1 from this PR: its era-0 test rows and skip guards are obsolete when this merges. (5) Found, not mine: the plain YouTube scorer accepts another song on the artist's own channel at the same length (Latin too). (6) Not done: slice 4, the phone's normalizeForMatch (B-46), the STOP-GAP expiry guard test (slice 4), walking, deploying. Removal trigger of the one-shot pieces: N-36.
